findings.title: Signed change capsules and publication/retrieval receipts do not bind the stated identity root to the signing key
findings.evidence: src/ucm/pippi_constitution.py: change_capsule_signing_body checks author_identity_root only as 64-hex (L347) and the key only as a valid key (L348); publication and retrieval signing bodies do the same for publisher_/retriever_identity_root. The builder's own test (tests/test_pippi_constitution.py L75) and the r028 court both sign with an arbitrary root (R[7], '8'*64). verify_passport already derives mosaic_id from the public key, and build_collaborator_binding uses it, so the binding is available but not applied.
findings.contradicts: docs/PIPPI-CONSTITUTIONAL-ATLAS.md step 7 ('binds ... identity') and test name test_signed_change_capsule_binds_base_delta_identity_and_dkn
findings.impact: A valid signature proves possession of some key, not that the named identity authored it; any key holder can attribute a capsule or receipt to any identity root. Mitigated by PROPOSAL_ONLY / no authority.
findings.repair: Require identity_root to equal the mosaic_id (or passport digest) derived from the signing key, or accept a passport and verify it; add a refusal case for a mismatched root.
findings.escalation_note: If the Governor treats the atlas doc's binding claim as an acceptance requirement, this is MED and r028 is HOLD_FOR_REPAIR.

findings.title: CCP transition binding derives PASS_READY from a caller-asserted status string
findings.evidence: build_ccp_transition_binding (L507-533) accepts current_use_status from the caller and sets transition_ready = not required or status == 'ADMIT'; current_use_decision_root is checked only as 64-hex and no CCP decision record is read or validated. The court's CCP-BYPASS-REFUSED case exercises only DEFER.
findings.impact: The binding records readiness that no CCP decision substantiates; 'CCP bypass' is on the work order's attack list. Mitigated: effect_authorized False, INFORMATION_ONLY.
findings.repair: Take the CCP current-use decision record, validate it, and derive status and decision root from it; add a court/test case for an unsubstantiated ADMIT.

findings.title: Retrieval receipt asserts hash verification the code never performs
findings.evidence: retrieval_receipt_signing_body hard-codes artifact_verified_after_retrieval: True (L492) and build_signed_retrieval_receipt sets custody_status RETRIEVED_AND_HASH_VERIFIED, but neither receives artifact bytes nor the publication receipt; artifact_sha256 is not compared with the publication receipt's artifact.
findings.contradicts: docs/PIPPI-CONSTITUTIONAL-ATLAS.md step 8 ('publication and retrieval receipts bind the same artifact hash')
findings.repair: Accept the publication receipt and the retrieved bytes (or compute the digest in-function) and require equality; otherwise label the field as a retriever attestation.

write_local_credential writes '<name>.pending' with plain write_bytes (not exclusive, follows symlinks); contents are AES-GCM encrypted and the module has no CLI or tool caller.
seal_local_credential accepts caller-supplied salt and nonce (defaults are os.urandom); caller reuse would repeat key and nonce.

Cold boot ships the mediated-agent SKILL.md only; its references (now including constitutional-atlas.md) are not at the linked relative path, though they are inside the embedded runtime. Pre-existing pattern.
